title: Partnership Training
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST EUROPE.W2SD ENDIST EUROPE
detail_text: The United States Army Corps of Engineers Europe District intends on awarding a sole-source contract to REBUILDING UKRAINE ASSOCIATION INCORPORATED (UEI: VLY9VCFK1NF4) in an amount not to exceed $250,000 for three courses tied to partnership training related to moving a direct execution agency to a modern project management organization. This is a non-commercial procurement under RFO 13.101(b).
